title: Adjust Time Stamp for Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transitions — daylight_saving_adjust
text: data_frame data frame two columns representing start end time visit, formatted "HH:MM:SS". date string "YYYY-MM-DD" format Date object. start_col Name column recording start time event (quoted), e.g.: start_col = "start" end_col Name column recording end time event (quoted). e.g.: end_col = "end" dst_df data frame created get_dst_switch_info, containing DST change dates times per year. daylight_change_duration integer fallback duration minutes (default = 60). tz valid time zone name (default time zone current physical location), used determine DST rules. Use OlsonNames() see valid options.

title: Adjust Time Stamp for Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transitions — daylight_saving_adjust
text: data frame adjusted daylight saving time, original data adjustment applies.

title: Adjust Time Stamp for Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transitions — daylight_saving_adjust
text: adjustment logic case follows: Fall DST Change Day (e.g., 1st Sunday November): North American clocks fall back 2:00 1:00 , repeating hour 1:00 2:00 . sensors repeat 1–2 hour instead continue recording 2–3 time never changed. function: Removes visits occur ambiguous hour (2:00 –3:00 , recorded). Shifts visits 3:00 back 1 hour align post-fallback clock time. Spring DST Change Day (e.g., 2nd Sunday March): North American clocks spring jump forward 2:00 3:00 , skipping hour 2–3 . sensors continue recording local time, resulting inconsistent timestamps. function: Removes visits start DST jump (2:00 ) end skipped hour (2:00–3:00 ). Shifts visits occur 2:00 forward 1 hour align new clock time. Day Spring DST Change: day spring DST change, sensors may still include late-night entries previous (DST) day, due time "-spill" function: Identifies first time point time resets (e.g., 23:00 01:00), based start time column. Removes rows backward time jump exclude spillover data DST change day.

title: Adjust Time Stamp for Daylight Saving Time (DST) Transitions — daylight_saving_adjust
code: dst_info <- get_dst_switch_info(years = 2021, tz = "America/Vancouver") df <- data.frame(Start = c("01:30:00", "02:30:00", "04:00:00"),                  End = c("02:00:00", "03:00:00", "04:30:00")) daylight_saving_adjust(df,                       date = "2021-11-07",                       start_col = "Start",                       end_col = "End",                       dst_df = dst_info,                       tz = "America/Vancouver") #>      Start       End #> 1 3H 0M 0S 3H 30M 0S

Default "feed" col_names Character vector names assign raw data columns. id_col Single string: column name animal IDs (default: "cow"). drop_ids Vector: values id_col remove (default: NULL). trans_col Single string: column name transponder IDs (default: "transponder"). start_col Name column recording start time event (quoted), e.g.: start_col = "start" end_col Name column recording end time event (quoted). e.g.: end_col = "end" drop_trans Vector: values trans_col remove (default: NULL). bin_col Single string: column name bin IDs (default: "bin"). bins Numeric vector: bin IDs keep (e.g. 2:4 c(1,5)). select_cols Character vector: columns retain final output. Default null, select columns. bin_offset Single numeric value add kept bin ID (default: 100). sep Field separator; passed read.table(). Defaults ",". header Logical; file header row? Defaults FALSE. daylight_change_duration integer fallback duration minutes (default = 60). tz valid time zone name (default time zone current physical location), used determine DST rules. Use OlsonNames() see valid options.

title: Process multiple files with time adjustment — process_all
text: named list data frames, one per input file, named date (YYYY‑MM‑DD).

title: Process multiple files with time adjustment — process_all
text: Steps: Validate inputs (types, file_type ∈ "feed","water"). Extract date information filename parse via lubridate::ymd(). Fetch Daylight Saving Time (DST) switch table relevant years (dst_switch_day(years, tz)). Loop file: 4.1. Call either process_feeder() process_water() : 4.1.1. Safely read CSV / DAT file 4.1.2. Rename columns 4.1.3. Drop unwanted cows & transponders 4.1.4. Keep specified bins 4.1.5. Subset desired columns 4.2. Drop rows NA. 4.3. Call daylight_saving_adjust() adjust timestamps daylight saving change days. 4.4. Standardize columns recording start end time event format "yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss". 4.5. Store processed dataframe output list name date.
